title: The 40-Year Farm Stand Dilemma
setting: Tucked along a winding country highway, the weathered wooden farm stand has operated continuously for 40 years, passed down through three local farming families. A commercial truck stop developer has filed plans to build adjacent to the stand’s small plot, threatening its loyal customer base and long-term viability. The current family owners face an impossible choice: take a substantial buyout or fight to preserve the community landmark they grew up with.

characters.name: Elara
characters.tendencies: She focuses solely on crunching financial numbers, comparing the buyout offer to the stand’s historical revenue to make a data-driven decision.

characters.name: Javi
characters.tendencies: He organizes neighborhood petitions and social media campaigns to rally support for saving the farm stand.

characters.name: Lila
characters.tendencies: She runs the stand’s daily operations, restocks fresh produce, and greets every regular customer by name.
